description: Ministry of Justice - Trust Ordinance Chapter 87 Order Under Section 114 Trustees of the "The Pastoral Fellowship Trust" Namely Rev. M. J.G. Jabakumar, Rev. K. Vijayan, Rev. P. Rasaretam Rev. K. Deiventhiran have applied to the Minister of Justice
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the legal incorporation of a trust under the Trusts Ordinance (Chapter 87).
